title: Hexen: Beyond Heretic
overview:
A new battle begins...

Defeat "Korax", the source of evil who created a world of darkness! Defeat Korax's minions and unravel the mysteries! And then, take back the world...

The realm of Cronos lies under the grip of Korax, one of the Serpent Riders. Choose one of three heroes and fight through this dark fantasy world in first-person 3D action, from elemental dungeons and wilderness to a castle and a necropolis.

The world is built from hubs: central areas linked to side levels you travel back and forth between, solving puzzles by collecting items and throwing switches before the way to the next hub opens.

- Three classes: the tough, fast Fighter, the balanced Cleric with melee and ranged attacks, and the long-range but fragile Mage
- Each class has its own weapons, and some items work differently depending on who uses them
- Carry an inventory of magic items to use when needed

新たな戦いが始まる…

暗黒の世界を創りあげた邪悪の根源「コラックス」を倒せ！
コラックスの手先を倒し、謎を解き明かせ！
そして、世界を取り戻すのだ…
